title: A probabilistic approach to the Yang--Baxter equation and skew braces
summary: We investigate finite non-degenerate set-theoretic solutions to the Yang--Baxter equation and skew braces using a probabilistic approach. We introduce four probabilities that measure how far a solution is from being a flip, but in different ways. Our main results state that for solutions arising from skew braces, these probabilities exhibit a rigid behaviour --- apart from a finite list of exceptional values (which we show to occur by means of explicit examples), they admit an upper bound that is slightly above $\frac{1}{2}$.
